admission.justification: Retiring a skill leaves dangling authority in every workflow that cited it; resolving them to the kept owners is the difference between a retirement and a broken lifecycle.

applicability: Every executable reference from a surviving lifecycle workflow to a closeout or carryover procedure.
conditions: Each reference resolves to a kept workflow that states the procedure.
The dated doctrine account stays as history and is not read as executable authority.

The retirement record names each retired section's surviving owner by path and range, its retained obligation and any gap, and stays marked as a historical diagnostic rather than a current certification.
exclusions: Rebuilding a retired skill to keep a reference alive.
statement: Every surviving executable closeout/carryover authority resolves to an exact kept workflow while dated doctrine history stays intact.
